value_exact_change: float inequality of paired options in identical predecision state
value_material_change: abs(delta)>1e-12+1e-9*max(abs(values)); observational diagnostic threshold, not a decision threshold
payload_choice_change: same signature ignoring rate and bits; same prestate makes record prefix identity comparable
failure_gate: Any original source hash mismatch, result mismatch, candidate-set mismatch or ledger identity failure stops interpretation; keep failed run
note: Same existing calibration worlds, no parameter change, no confirmatory test or new task-effect sample. Shadow value call does not advance alternative trajectory. Diagnostic wall time is not deployment inference cost.
